route_decisions.label: Ollama localhost
route_decisions.reason: The attached research report explicitly allows this local route for R01-C only; model license, hardware fit, loopback and owner approval before download remain mandatory.
route_decisions.data_gate: local data path; exact model license and dataset classification still apply

route_decisions.label: LM Studio localhost
route_decisions.reason: The attached report explicitly allows LM Studio localhost for R01-C only, with no external network/API requirement and approval before model download.
route_decisions.data_gate: local data path; exact model license and dataset classification still apply

route_decisions.label: OpenAI API directa
route_decisions.reason: Technical authentication does not establish contractual entitlement, data handling suitability or budget approval; external provider runtime remains disabled.
route_decisions.data_gate: fresh terms/privacy/region + data classification + secret injection + owner budget approval

route_decisions.label: Anthropic API directa
route_decisions.reason: External API route remains conditional pending provider-specific fresh terms/privacy/region freeze and controlled credentials/budget.
route_decisions.data_gate: fresh terms/privacy/region + data classification + approved secret handling

route_decisions.label: Gemini API paid
route_decisions.reason: Attached research distinguishes paid services from unpaid services and states a different data-use regime; paid access still requires provider-specific contractual/privacy/region gates.
route_decisions.data_gate: DPA/terms/privacy/region freeze + data classification + logging controls

route_decisions.label: Gemini API unpaid
route_decisions.reason: The attached report explicitly blocks unpaid Gemini for confidential code, PII and non-public DevPilot datasets due to the documented unpaid-service data-use regime.
route_decisions.data_gate: BLOCK for non-public/confidential/PII; no DevPilot external runtime enablement

route_decisions.label: Azure OpenAI
route_decisions.reason: Cloud route requires exact subscription/region/data-processing configuration and contractual review; report does not authorize runtime enablement.
route_decisions.data_gate: exact Azure region, identity, DPA, retention/logging and dataset classification

route_decisions.label: AWS Bedrock
route_decisions.reason: Report identifies invocation logging, retention and cross-region behavior as configuration-sensitive; route must pin model, retention mode, source region and inference profile.

route_decisions.label: Mistral API
route_decisions.reason: The attached report explicitly states that authentication is documented but evidence was insufficient to freeze all Colombia processing/residency/contract variables; unknown is retained rather than inferred.
route_decisions.data_gate: BLOCK from allow until CO contractual/processing/residency evidence is frozen

route_decisions.label: OpenRouter
route_decisions.reason: Broker route is conditional and must pin the downstream provider; dynamic fallback to unevaluated providers is not allowed.
route_decisions.data_gate: downstream provider/route, logging, ZDR/retention and data policy must be frozen

route_decisions.label: Remote OpenAI-compatible genérico
route_decisions.reason: Protocol compatibility does not inherit OpenAI terms, privacy, region or behavior. Provider identity and contract/data path are unresolved.
route_decisions.data_gate: provider identity + official terms/privacy/region required before any allow

route_decisions.label: Consumer web session piggyback
route_decisions.reason: Prompt and report explicitly prohibit browser/DOM/cookie piggyback and reuse of consumer sessions as provider integration.

route_decisions.label: Consumer subscription como API
route_decisions.reason: Consumer subscription is not evidence of API/programmatic entitlement; the prompt explicitly forbids this equivalence.
route_decisions.data_gate: BLOCK unless an official supported programmatic mechanism is separately reviewed

route_decisions.label: Long-tail R01-A no congelado contractualmente
route_decisions.reason: The report retains long-tail routes as unknown until provider-specific auth/terms/privacy/region evidence is frozen. Unknown is not a failure and does not authorize use.
